dct_creator_sm: Wood, Claudia (School of Environmental Sciences. Ontario Agricultural College. University of Guelph.).
dct_description_sm:
Supplementary Data files for MSc thesis by Claudia Wood - "Microbial Ecology of Dry Permafrost from Elephant Head, Antarctica".  SupplementaryFile_1_16S_ASVs - contains 16S rRNA gene sequences, their closest environment match and contaminant ranking SupplementaryFile_2_ITS_ASVs - contains ITS2 gene sequences 
SupplementaryFile_3_Arthrobacter - contains description of Arthrobacter species including growth temperatures from the literature.
dct_title_s: Microbial Ecology of Dry Permafrost from Elephant Head, Antarctica - Supplementary Data
